paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot, chapter 5, at the end of halakhah 1, reporting in the name of R' Yochanan. He is also mentioned in Gittin, chapter 3, halakhah 2.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״א is read as end of halakhah 1, retaining the initial end marker omitted by older first-halakhah wording. Ketubot chapter 5 is explicitly Jerusalem Talmud; the Gittin chapter 3 halakhah 2 continuation is naturally the same corpus, without a repeated corpus label or independently checked edition.

The implicit reporting subject is naturally the headed Yose, but grammatical compression is not a new identity proof. The inherited prior_guess_provisional/uncertain_from_scan heading status remains unadjudicated. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'; the unprefixed father Zeira gains no title.
